highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 previews the Graphite GPU backend, async pixel readback, and Skia milestone 152.
highlights_body: It adds Vulkan/Metal/Dawn Graphite bindings, a backend-neutral async RequestReadPixels API, a new SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package, Nano Server font support, and several native use-after-free and leak fixes.

bullets.detail: Bundles the Skia m152 engine, rolls up upstream chrome/m151 stability fixes, and refreshes the bundled HarfBuzz to 14.2.1.
Adds Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn, giving access to Skia's next-generation GPU backend.
Adds a backend-neutral async RequestReadPixels API to SKImage and SKSurface for non-blocking pixel reads.
Adds the SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package and enables Vulkan tests on Android and Linux.
Uses FreeType to enable font rendering on Windows Nano Server containers.
Fixes a native use-after-free in SKRegion.SpanIterator, a use-after-free in SKPixmap.ExtractSubset and With* methods, and a CoTaskMem pixel-buffer leak in SKImage.Create's raster failure path.
Adds containerized test legs for Azure Linux, Alpine/musl, and Nano Server, and initializes the MSVC environment once per native build on Windows.
